_about: Arthur Fairbanks (1864-1944), classical archaeologist and Director of the Boston Museum of Fine Arts: The Mythology of Greece and Rome (1907), A Handbook of Greek Religion (1910), Athenian Lekythoi (1907), A Study of the Greek Paean (1900), and Greek Gods and Heroes (MFA, 1915). His First Philosophers of Greece (1898) is already on the presocratics shelf; his sociology is outside lane B. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dc). Raw IA OCR unless a Gutenberg text is named. No uids minted.
